title: Can I DEVOUR Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess online vs humans with the goal of winning three games. Tony sees his own drawback (Social Distancing, Boastful, Eye for an Eye) while opponents' are hidden until the end (Skittish, Leading the Charge, Just Passing Through). He wins all three games.
rules: Each player gets one random drawback; own drawback visible, opponent's hidden until the game ends.
King-capture Drawback rules (capture the king to win; losing conditions from drawbacks).

Own drawbacks seen: Social Distancing — you cannot make non-capturing moves to squares adjacent to your opponent's pieces. Boastful — you lose if you have fewer pieces than your opponent. Eye for an Eye — if your opponent captures, you must capture on your next move or lose.

Opponent drawbacks seen: Skittish — while in check you must move your king. Leading the Charge — as long as you have a knight, you cannot move non-knights ahead of your most advanced knight. Just Passing Through — you can't capture on the fourth rank.
Intro examples: Lame Duck — you can't move your king; True Gentleman — you can never capture a queen.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king / opponent loses by drawback; goal: 3 wins (achieved).
